column4: The staircase shortcut now appears beside the hotbar by default; an explicitly disabled preference stays disabled.
Enabling Automatic Stair Navigation explains where to tap for Stairs Up and Stairs Down.
Added preference reload checks and a native dungeon test that opens the shortcut without force-enabling it.
Chalice inspection and confirmation show the next prick's base damage, full reduced range, HP loss after shields and current HP.
The warning considers temporary defenses, Antimagic, Cape activation and the Warrior's shield; Life Link is explicitly marked unpredictable.
Added Chalice range, actual-damage, save and RNG checks, corrected the stair-default expectation and required an Android item-window screenshot.
Recorded the failed TEST84 attempt, successful preceding verification and the new preview's mechanics and limitations.
I made the staircase shortcut easier to discover and added a Chalice preview that uses your current defenses. It warns about the worst outcome rather than suggesting an average hit is safe.
